{{Quote|&hellip;treasury ship ''Walker'' and Corvette escort attacked and several damaged by six Rebel X-wings in Fakir sector&hellip;|An extract from a report authored by the [[Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War]]|<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
A '''treasure ship''',<ref name="Pirate" /> also known as a '''treasury ship''',<ref name="SWS" /> was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used to carry valuables.<ref name="Pirate" /> Both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used treasury ships. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Fandar (pirate)|Fandar]] teamed up with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to raid [[Unidentified Imperial treasury ship|one such vessel]], but was betrayed by [[Fandar's right-hand man|his right hand man]]. The Rebels and pirates were led into an ambush.<ref name="Pirate" /> At some point, the treasury ship [[Walker (treasury ship)|''Walker'']] was attacked by six [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. The ''Walker'' and its [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] escort suffered heavy damage.<ref name="SWS" />
